value.rationale: Singleton and doubleton component counts are natural adjacent cluster-size statistics. The theorem gives sharp sign behavior for all edge-retention probabilities, identifying the first branching degree at which uniform arm subdivision forces permanent negative covariance, contrasting both unsubdivided stars and the two-arm path. This is a structural phase boundary rather than a tiny numerical improvement.
